title: Universal Value-at-Risk superadditivity
abstract: arXiv:2606.22884v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Value-at-Risk (VaR) is a standard regulatory risk measure, and its failure of subadditivity is well known. Much less appreciated is that for sufficiently heavy-tailed losses, VaR can be superadditive uniformly across all probability levels, a phenomenon strictly stronger than the asymptotic superadditivity studied in extreme value theory. We call this property universal VaR superadditivity (UVS). We study UVS and its stronger weighted version (WUVS) as properties of random vectors rather than of marginal distributions. This perspective unifies and extends a recent line of work on iid infinite-mean models. UVS, except for trivial cases, imposes an infinite-mean structure. translated_title: 普遍的风险价值超可加性
translated_abstract: 风险价值是标准的监管风险度量，其不满足次可加性的缺陷早已广为人知。然而鲜为人知的是，对于足够重尾的损失，VaR 可以在所有概率水平上一致地呈现超可加性，这一现象严格强于极值理论中所研究的渐近超可加性。我们将这一性质称为普遍VaR超可加性（UVS）。我们将 UVS 及其更强的加权版本（WUVS）视为随机向量的性质而非边缘分布的性质来加以研究。这一视角统一并扩展了近期关于独立同分布无穷均值模型的一系列工作。除平凡情形外，UVS 蕴含无穷均值结构。我们建立了 UVS 与 WUVS 在单调递增与凸变换、弱收敛以及某些分布混合下的保持性质，并利用这些工具证明了在若干大家族中非同分布风险（原文在此处截断）的 UVS 与 WUVS 成立。
tldr: 该论文提出“普遍VaR超可加性”（UVS）这一新概念——即重尾损失下VaR在所有概率水平上一致超可加，并将其作为随机向量的性质系统研究了其在单调凸变换、弱收敛和分布混合下的保持性质，进而证明了多个非同分布风险家族中UVS与WUVS的成立。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "universal VaR superadditivity" (UVS), where VaR is superadditive uniformly across all probability levels for sufficiently heavy-tailed losses, studies UVS and its weighted version WUVS as properties of random vectors, establishes their preservation under increasing convex transformations, weak convergence, and distributional mixtures, and proves them for non-identically distributed risks in several large families.
